title: api-evangelist/oxen
description: Oxen.ai is a blazing-fast data version control system and AI platform for teams building with their own data. Its open-source Rust core (liboxen) versions, branches, and shares terabyte-scale datasets, model weights, and experiments without Git's large-file limits.
raw_text_excerpt: Oxen.ai is a blazing-fast data version control system and AI platform for teams building with their own data. Its open-source Rust core (liboxen) versions, branches, and shares terabyte-scale datasets, model weights, and experiments without Git's large-file limits.
